Caveats + original: Reported overall phase and normalized phase-3-or-worse share of the frozen global origin-safe cohort. Undefined source values are not logged; view/na.json lists them with the source reason. Metric keys read ..; view/evaluation_view.json maps every key to the source file, row and column. External catalog descriptor of saved XGBoost boosters: the weights are downloadable from the detailed parent run (members.json lists every member and its bundle); there is no MLflow prediction wrapper and nothing was retrained. Source snapshot: compact_global_2026_extension. MLflow times are registration times, not fit times.
